Oktoberfest 2026! October 8, 4:30-6:30

The Department of German Studies, in collaboration with Allen House and West House, invite you to Oktoberfest 2026!

Oktoberfest is a 200+ year old cultural festival originating in Munich, Germany, and prides itself on being the largest folk festival in the world.

Annually, German Studies at Dartmouth likes to pay homage to this traditional festival by hosting a small celebration with food, games, music, and more.

Thanks to the generous support of Allen House & West House, we anticipate this year’s Oktoberfest at Dartmouth to be the best one yet!

Please join us on Thursday, October 8th from 4:30-6:30 at The Cube. There will be food, music, and perhaps even a few surprises!
